testcase.name: Scenario: Select and clears multiple recent-document rows: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-home-recent-documents-source/features/application/home-recent-documents/home-recent-documents.feature:116:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Select and clears multiple recent-document rows ✔ Given the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native` ✔ And the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And recent documents are displayed in List View ✔ And one recent-document row is checked and no other rows are checked ✔ When the user checks a second recent-document row ✔ Then both rows are checked and highlighted ✔ And Open Selected and Remove Selected appear above the list ✔ When the user clears the second row's checkbox ✔ Then the first row remains checked ✔ And the selected-item actions remain visible ✔ When the user clears the first row's checkbox ✔ Then no recent-document rows are checked ✔ And Open Selected and Remove Selected are no longer displayed above the list
